# P1.18 — Export, full formats + provenance appendix + account zip

Spec: `docs/tickets/46_P1.18__export-full.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.18.md`
**Stage A only** — code + deterministic tests at $0. Stage B (deploy the extended export image,
live format exports through the Job, the live account-zip email leg — $0 inference by design,
≤$3) is operator-gated → `D-P1.18-1`. The merge is **operator-held**.

Stacks on `stevevitali/p1-17-landing-onboarding` (P1.17).

## Summary

Export is the only way out (Q-9) — this completes the §13.4 contract: `html`, `pdf` (Typst),
`rtf`, and `latex` join `md`/`txt`/`docx`; `--citeproc` renders the five MVP CSL styles;
footnotes and figures carry per-format fidelity (REQ-VIZ-15); the block-level provenance
appendix ships behind one off-by-default toggle with honestly labelled granularity; the Op-ed
exclusivity reminder and the Academic disclosure surface land (degrading to the general AI-use
statement until P1.21 registers the ICMJE template); Substack-flavoured md is a *profile* of md;
and the whole-account export zip round-trips into a fresh account under a golden test.

## What changed

- **Registry** (`packages/contracts/src/domain/export.ts`): `EXPORT_FORMATS` extended to
  `md, txt, html, docx, rtf, pdf, latex` with each format's pandoc target, standalone flag, and
  file extension (`.tex`); `pdf` rides pandoc's `pdf` writer with `--pdf-engine=typst` so the
  figure/asset rewrite path stays single. `MD_EXPORT_PROFILES = { substack }` — a profile, never
  an eighth format. `CSL_STYLES` = APA / MLA / Chicago author-date / Harvard / Vancouver (the
  conventional five, recorded per ticket instruction). `PROVENANCE_APPENDIX_FORMATS` =
  `md/html/pdf/docx/latex` — `txt`/`rtf` omitted per the spec's own enumeration.
- **`apps/export`** (the isolated container — the only image carrying pandoc + typst):
  `pandoc.ts` stages sidecars (bibliography CSL-JSON, `.csl` style, figure asset bytes) under a
  per-run temp dir and passes `--bibliography`/`--csl`/`--citeproc`/`--resource-path`;
  `export.ts` validates profile/style/format combinations **before** any exec;
  `figures.ts` implements the REQ-VIZ-15 rewrite — `render.svg` for html/pdf/latex,
  `render@2x.png` (decoded bytes) for docx/rtf, native-table pass-through, txt keeps
  alt + caption + source lines, `[unverified data]` lands as a caption note, a no-payload marker
  degrades to alt text, the dark render is never referenced, and md appends a `## Figure sources`
  appendix carrying spec + data + provenance while the canonical body stays byte-faithful;
  `substack.ts` strips comments/figure markers and flattens footnotes into a `## Notes` list;
  `csl-styles.ts` inlines five **Rhema-authored** CSL 1.0.2 styles (the upstream Zotero repo is
  CC-BY-SA — outside the allowlist; authoring avoids a new exception);
  `Dockerfile` pins `PANDOC_VERSION=3.10` + `TYPST_VERSION=0.13.1` (official musl-static
  releases; Typst is Apache-2.0 — no licence exception needed).
- **Provenance appendix** (`packages/mirror/src/provenance-appendix.ts`): renders a `## Provenance`
  appendix from `provenance_maps.spans` — looked up by `draft_version_id` resolved through the
  current draft head's promoted artifact version (never by project id). Each row carries the
  block id, a 60-char `splitMarkdownBlocks` excerpt, and `provenanceSourceLabel`; author-edited
  blocks degrade to *mixed* with the wording stated outright; the appendix states plainly that
  span-level provenance is recorded but not exported at MVP (REQ-POS-10 stays 1.x). Off by
  default, one dialog toggle, appendix-capable formats only.
- **Disclosure surfaces** (`packages/ai-use` + api dialog): `registerStatementTemplate` /
  `templateForProtocol` — a process-local template registry so P1.21's ICMJE variant slots in
  without touching export code; until it registers, the Academic surface degrades to the general
  statement (a service, never a gate). The dialog DTO gains `surfaces` — Academic ⇒ the
  disclosure surface (protocol-id fallback when the integrity-norms row is absent, §6.7); Op-ed
  ⇒ the verbatim exclusivity reminder line. The AI-use attach toggle is unchanged.
- **`@rhema/archive` (new package)** — `buildAccountZip`: every project in its on-disk layout
  (`manifest.md`, `drafts/`, `correspondence/`, `agents/author/*` — `agents/editor/*`, `.rhema/`,
  and internal kinds excluded), every voice (`PERSONA.md`, `docs/`, `profile/` incl. the
  calibration report), samples as canonical markdown under the voice tree, figure asset files,
  `ledger.csv` (§14.5 columns), a `manifest.json` per-file sha256 index, and a portable
  `state.json` including the §11.7 preference-profile rows (export-only — import ignores them).
  Deterministic: sorted files, fixed timestamps, seeded-random-free. `importAccountZip` replays
  the state into a fresh workspace under deterministic `importedId(workspace|kind|originalId)`
  ids with `on conflict do nothing` — re-import is `deduped`, never a duplicate.
- **Delivery machinery** — migration `0038_account_export.sql` (`account_exports`:
  `building|ready|failed`, zip sha/bytes/object key, **hashed** download token, `expires_at =
  created_at + 7 days`); api `account-export-routes.ts` (`POST /account/export` — one in-flight
  per workspace, `GET /account/export` status, `GET /account/export/:id/:token` download — 410
  past expiry, `POST /account/import`); worker `export-jobs.ts` consumes `account.export` —
  builds the zip, stores bytes through the object-store seam, flips the row, emails the expiring
  link through the existing mailer; the token never persists plaintext and never appears in a
  public response.
- **Web** — the export dialog renders the full format list with per-format blurbs, the
  `md:substack` profile radio, the CSL-style select (bibliography-gated), the unchecked-by-default
  provenance toggle, the exclusivity/disclosure surfaces; account export/import surfaces and
  download handling; `api-client` DTOs + methods extended.

## Non-goals (ticket's own Out of scope)

odt/epub/Google Docs; "Send to Substack" (Later); 10 CSL styles (1.x); span-granular provenance
export (REQ-POS-10, 1.x); the ICMJE template *content* (P1.21); the Settings → Data trigger UI
(P1.20 calls this ticket's API route). Any merge — `mergePolicy: OPERATOR`.
